name: roofs_retail_a
prompt:
Image 1 is the layout to paint into: 9 building outlines seen from above on flat magenta, in a 3×3 grid. Paint only its transparent areas, each of which holds one outline: cells 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8. Everything else stays exactly as it is. Image 2 is finished art from the same game, to match in style only.

The fault of both earlier attempts at these cells: every roof was drawn 10–30% bigger than its outline and shifted off it, spilling past its edges. Each roof is exactly the size of its outline's light-grey shape in image 1, no bigger: its four edges lie on the outline's four edges, the same corners, nothing past them, no magenta inside.

Look straight down (orthographic): no perspective, no walls seen from the side, no ground, plants, cars or people. The thick bottom edge of each outline is the street front. A flat roof has a thin parapet, about 0.3 m, round its edge. Style: clean, flat-shaded cartoon game art, bold dark outlines, muted natural colours, soft light from the top-left. No text, letters, numbers or logos.

Details at true size; these buildings stand beside cars 4 m long: an air conditioner unit about 1 × 1 m; a vent about 0.5 m; a plain sign strip about 0.6 m deep along the front, inside the outline.

1. 3.9 × 2.6 m (1.5× wider than deep) — small street booth or stall, flat painted sheet-metal roof with a sign along the front edge
2. 5.2 × 3.9 m (1.3× wider than deep) — small street booth or stall, flat painted sheet-metal roof with a sign along the front edge
3. 6.5 × 4.5 m (1.4× wider than deep) — single-storey shop pavilion, flat grey roof with an air conditioner unit and a sign along the front edge
4. 3.9 × 5.2 m (1.3× deeper than wide) — small street booth or stall, flat painted sheet-metal roof with a sign along the front edge, standing narrow end to the street with the entrance on that short front wall
5. 7.8 × 5.9 m (1.3× wider than deep) — single-storey shop pavilion, flat grey roof with an air conditioner unit and a sign along the front edge
7. 9.1 × 7.2 m (1.3× wider than deep) — single-storey shop pavilion, flat grey roof with an air conditioner unit and a sign along the front edge
8. 5.2 × 7.8 m (1.5× deeper than wide) — single-storey shop pavilion, flat grey roof with an air conditioner unit and a sign along the front edge, standing narrow end to the street with the entrance on that short front wall
